slides.heading: Equal vs Assignment
slides.body: Equal vs Assignment is part of Boolean Logic and Comparisons. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: Equal vs Assignment
slides.body: The single equals sign = assigns a value. The double equals sign == compares two values for equality.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: Assignment is putting a label on a box, while equality comparison checks whether two labels match.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: Boolean expressions must produce True or False. Use comparisons and logical operators carefully.

slides.heading: Try It Yourself!
slides.prompt: Assign password to "open", then check if it equals "open".

coding_challenge.prompt_text: Set code to 1234 and print whether code equals 1111.
coding_challenge.hint_text: Use the idea from the lesson. Keep the code short, readable, and correctly indented.
